evidence.maker: AP63203: FB is the "feedback sensing terminal for the output voltage", VFB = 3.27-3.30-3.33 V for the fixed AP63203, internal 0.8 V reference and a 0.6 V UVP comparator on the FB path (Diodes DS41326 Rev 3-2, pp 2, 3, 5: https://www.diodes.com/assets/Datasheets/AP63200-AP63201-AP63203-AP63205.pdf). TPS7A91 FB "input to the control loop error amplifier" (TI SBVS282A p4, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps7a91.pdf). TPS2553: the current limit is proportional to the current sourced out of ILIM (TI SLVS841G section 8, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps2553.pdf), so an open ILIM leg lowers the limit (fail-safe, Inference).

findings.impact: The class D-R20-02 made a gate rule (a regulator losing its sense through one cracked via barrel) is checked for one pad. On the board as committed the 3V3 buck's only output-sense connection is the via (23.20, 68.60): open, U2.1 is left on 0.85 mm of track. With its sense gone the AP63203 loop no longer sees the output; whether it then runs to VLOGIC (up to about 8.4 V) or trips its 0.6 V UVP comparator is not specified by the maker (Inference), and the STM32H743, IMU and barometer on 3V3 are 4.0 V absolute-maximum parts. U401.3 (PORT_LDO_FB) and R87.1 (USB OV sense) are the same class with milder outcomes (PORT_4V8 open-loop as R20-PWR-02; USB over-voltage cut-off disabled); the ILIM opens fail low. A manufacturing / vibration defect path, not a design error on intact copper: Minor, as R20-PWR-02 was.
findings.concrete_fix: CAD: give U2.1 a second barrel, e.g. the f01b run (24.05, 68.95)-(23.0, 70.0) on B.Cu (or a centred entry the routing lane prefers); a second PORT_LDO_FB via beside (29.75, 13.60) where room allows. Gate: add ('3V3', 'U2.1', ('L1.2',)) and ('USB_LIMITED', 'R87.1', ('U10.6',)) to SINGLE_OPEN_TAPS, and hold every regulator FB / OV / EN tap through a named list whose remaining single points (U401.3 until respin, D-R20-01 R81 / C87, and the fail-low ILIM legs R85 / R430) are exact entries with a measured reason that fail as stale, as POUR_DEBRIS does.

findings.impact: REQUIREMENTS M2 asks for design rules within JLC's limits. Two 1.3 mm terminal holes now sit 0.05 mm inside the published inner-layer limit: J1.2 (battery GND) against In2 RAW_PROTECTED and J400.2 (BAT_SW_RETURN) against In1 GND. Drill wander or smear there gives a RAW_PROTECTED-GND short behind U9 (U9 limits, board dead) or holds EN low (board will not turn on): no hazardous direction, but a yield / DFM-hold risk the gate cannot see because DRC uses the project rule and S-8 exempts these nets. D-R20-05's record states the 0.25 mm but not that it is below the fab limit.
findings.concrete_fix: Add the f02 DRU rule (inner layers, PTH pads, hole_clearance 0.3 mm), refill (the fill steps back to 0.301 mm at both barrels), re-pin DRU_SHA256 in tools/check_r10.py, rebuild and rebind. Optionally pin the JLC table (via 0.2 / PTH 0.3 inner, PTH 0.28 outer, pad hole-to-hole 0.45) in K-rules so a later DRU edit cannot drop below it.
